app.name: CareNest
app.tagline: Coordinate care for the people you love — together, from anywhere.

common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.errorNetwork: We couldn't reach CareNest. Check your internet connection and try again.
common.notAllowed: You don't have permission to see this.

landing.intro: One shared place for medicines, appointments, caregiver visits and family tasks — so everyone knows what has been done and what still needs someone.
landing.featureMedsBody: Reminders and confirmations. An unanswered reminder is shown as unconfirmed — never assumed taken or missed.
landing.featureFamilyBody: Every task, appointment and ride has a named person, or is clearly marked as still needing one.
landing.featureDignityBody: A simple, large-text view for parents, with privacy choices that stay in their hands.

safety.notEmergencyService: CareNest is not an emergency service. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
auth.name: Your name
auth.timeZoneHint: Times are shown in this zone. You can change it later.

home.intro: Care circles, medicines and schedules will appear here as they are set up.
home.noCircles: You're not part of a care circle yet.
home.noCirclesHint: A care circle is the group of people who look after one person — family, caregivers and anyone else they trust. Create one, or ask a family member to invite you.

account.title: Your account
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
account.devicesIntro: If you don't recognise a device, or a shared tablet should no longer be signed in, sign it out here.
account.noOtherDevices: No other devices are signed in.

roleHints.care_recipient: The person this circle is for. They see their own information and, if they manage their own care, decide what is shared.
roleHints.admin: Manages the circle: invites people, edits the profile and coordinates.
roleHints.family: Sees shared updates, takes on tasks and appointments.
roleHints.caregiver: Sees assigned care tasks, medicines and visits.
roleHints.clinician: Sees medicines, appointments and health notes. CareNest does not verify professional credentials.
roleHints.emergency_contact: Only receives emergency alerts and sees the emergency information card.

circle.newIntro: Tell us about the person you're caring for. You can change all of this later.
circle.creatorAdmin: I'm a family member or friend organising care
circle.creatorSelf: I'm the person who will receive care
circle.preferredName: What do they like to be called?
circle.preferredNameHint: Shown in reminders and on their screen.
circle.timeZoneHint: Medicine times and visits follow this time zone, wherever the family lives.
circle.countryHint: Used to show the right emergency number.
circle.selfManaging: Can they make their own care and privacy decisions?
circle.selfManagingYes: Yes — they decide what is shared with family
circle.selfManagingNo: No — they need someone to decide for them
circle.selfManagingHint: Choose “Yes” unless they truly can't. They can always see their own information.
circle.noAccount: Doesn't have a CareNest account yet
circle.comingSoon: Medicines, appointments, tasks and visits will appear here as each part of CareNest is switched on.
circle.inviteTemporaryHint: For temporary help, such as a relief caregiver. Leave empty for ongoing access.
circle.inviteCreated: Invitation created. CareNest can't send emails yet, so share this link with them yourself. It works once and expires in 7 days:
circle.leaveConfirm: You will lose access to this circle immediately. Continue?
circle.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from this circle? They lose access immediately.
circle.privacyIntro: Caregivers and healthcare professionals in the circle always see what they need to give care. These choices control what family members and admins can see.
circle.privacyAdmin: Family admins decide these settings because {name} does not manage their own care decisions.
circle.shareHealth: Health details (date of birth, health notes)
circle.autonomyOn: {name} currently manages their own care decisions.
circle.autonomyOff: {name}'s care decisions are currently made with family.
circle.autonomyConfirm: This changes who controls privacy and membership. It is recorded in the activity log. Continue?
circle.archiveIntro: Archiving makes the circle read-only. Nothing is deleted and everyone keeps read access.
circle.archiveConfirm: Archive this circle? It becomes read-only for everyone.
circle.isArchived: This circle is archived and read-only.
circle.activityIntro: A record of important changes, so {name} and the admins can see who did what.
circle.inviteEmailed: We've emailed them an invitation. You can also share this link yourself. It works once and expires in 7 days:

invite.title: You're invited
invite.body: {inviter} invited you to join “{circle}”, the care circle for {recipient}, as: {role}.
invite.status_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask {inviter} to send a new one.
invite.status_accepted: This invitation has already been used.
invite.invalid: This invitation link isn't valid. Check you copied the whole link.

audit.consent_updated: changed what is shared with family
audit.member_updated: changed a member's role or access
audit.appointment_companion_changed: changed who is going along to {name}
audit.assistance_acknowledged: responded to a request for help
audit.circle_exported: downloaded a full copy of the circle's records

meds.noDoses: No scheduled doses on this day.
meds.unconfirmedHelp: Nobody has confirmed this dose yet. Check with {name} or their caregiver. Don't give an extra dose to make up for it unless a doctor or pharmacist says so.
meds.shifted: Clocks changed today, so this dose moved from {time}.
meds.noMedicines: No medicines have been added yet.
meds.lowSupply: Running low — time to arrange a refill.
meds.stopConfirm: Stop this medicine? It stays in the history, and upcoming doses are removed.
meds.formIntro: Enter the medicine exactly as the doctor or pharmacist prescribed it. CareNest never suggests or changes doses.
meds.name: Medicine name
meds.dosageHint: As written on the prescription, e.g. “1 tablet (500 mg)”.
meds.times: Times to take it (their local time)
meds.refillThreshold: Warn when this many are left (optional)
meds.notShared: {name} has chosen not to share medicines with family.

notif.reminderSelfBody: {dosage}. When you've taken it, tap “I took it”.
notif.reminderEmailBody: A medicine is due now. Open CareNest to see it and confirm it: {link}
notif.unconfirmedBody: {medicine} ({dosage}) was due at {time} their time. Nobody has confirmed it yet — that doesn't mean it was missed. Check in with {name}, then record what happened. Tap “I'm checking on it” so others know.
notif.unconfirmedEmailSubject: A medicine for {name} hasn't been confirmed
notif.unconfirmedEmailBody: A medicine that was due for {name} hasn't been confirmed yet. Open CareNest to see details and let others know you're checking: {link}
notif.escalatedBody: {medicine} was due at {time} their time and is still unconfirmed, and nobody has said they are checking. Please check on {name}.
notif.escalatedEmailBody: A medicine for {name} is still unconfirmed and nobody has said they are checking. Open CareNest: {link}
notif.refillBody: {count} left for {name}. Time to arrange a refill.
notif.refillEmailSubject: A medicine for {name} is running low
notif.refillEmailBody: One of {name}'s medicines is running low. Open CareNest to see which: {link}
notif.apptEmailBody: {name} has an appointment coming up. Open CareNest for the details: {link}
notif.transportBody: {title} is on {when} ({name}'s time) and nobody has said they will drive. Can you? Open the appointment and tap “I'll drive”.
notif.transportEmailSubject: {name} needs a ride to an appointment
notif.transportEmailBody: Nobody has offered to take {name} to an upcoming appointment yet. Open CareNest: {link}
notif.taskDueBody: You took on “{title}” for {name}. It's due {when}.
notif.taskUnassignedBody: “{title}” for {name} is due {when} and nobody has taken it. Tap “I'll do it” if you can.
notif.taskOverdueBody: “{title}” for {name} was due {when} and is still open. {who}
notif.taskEmailSubject: A care task for {name} needs attention
notif.taskEmailBody: A task in {name}'s care circle needs attention. Open CareNest: {link}
notif.visitSummaryHidden: Details are visible only to people {name} shares health information with.
notif.visitEmailBody: There's a visit update in {name}'s care circle. Open CareNest: {link}
notif.visitCancelledBody: Reason: {reason}. Someone may need to cover this visit.
notif.visitNotCheckedInTitle: {visitor} hasn't checked in for the {time} visit
notif.visitNotCheckedInBody: The visit with {name} was planned for {time}. This doesn't mean they didn't come — check-ins are self-reported. Check with {visitor} or {name}.
notif.visitCheckInReminderTitle: Please check in for your {time} visit
notif.visitCheckInReminderBody: Your visit with {name} was planned for {time}. Tap “I've arrived” when you're there, or let the family know if you can't come.
notif.updateEmailBody: {author} posted an important update in {name}'s care circle. Open CareNest: {link}
notif.assistBody: {message}{location}CareNest has NOT contacted emergency services. If this is an emergency, call {number}. Open CareNest and tap “I'm responding” so others know.
notif.assistEmailBody: Someone in {name}'s care circle asked for help. CareNest has NOT contacted emergency services — if this is an emergency, call {number}. Open CareNest now: {link}
notif.assistAckTitle: {responder} is responding to {name}'s request for help
notif.assistCancelledTitle: False alarm: {name}'s request for help was cancelled
notif.digestIntro: Here is what happened today that you haven't seen in CareNest yet:
notif.digestFooter:
See everything: {link}
You can turn this daily summary off under Account → Notifications.
notif.pushTestBody: Alerts are working on this device.

inbox.title: Notifications
inbox.youAreChecking: You said you're checking on this.
inbox.email_pending: Email: waiting to be sent (for example until your quiet hours end)
inbox.email_logged: Email: not sent — this server has no email provider set up

prefs.title: Notifications
prefs.intro: Notifications always appear in CareNest. You can also get a copy by email.
prefs.email: Also send me notifications by email
prefs.digest: Send me one email each evening with the day's everyday news (visits, updates)
prefs.digestHint: Urgent and important alerts still come straight away.
prefs.quietIntro: During quiet hours, emails wait until the quiet hours end. Urgent alerts are always sent straight away.
prefs.noEmailProvider: Note: this CareNest server has no email provider set up, so emails are not actually sent yet.

alerts.title: My alerts for this circle
alerts.doseReminders: Reminders when a medicine is due
alerts.unconfirmedDoses: Alerts when a dose hasn't been confirmed
alerts.refills: Alerts when a medicine is running low
alerts.notShared: You won't get medicine alerts because {name} has chosen not to share medicines with family.
alerts.escalationNote: Admins always receive urgent follow-ups if a dose stays unconfirmed and nobody is checking.
alerts.introGeneral: Choose which alerts you get about {name}. These choices only affect you.
alerts.appointments: Appointment reminders, and alerts when nobody has offered to take {name}
alerts.tasks: Alerts about tasks nobody has taken on, or that are overdue
alerts.commitments: You always hear about things you've taken on yourself, such as a task assigned to you or a drive you offered.
alerts.noneAvailable: There are no alerts for you to choose in this circle.

appts.cancelConfirm: Cancel this appointment? Everyone in the circle will see it was cancelled.
appts.title: What is it for?
appts.questionsHint: Anyone can add questions here before the visit.
appts.notBooked: This shows who has offered to take {name}. It isn't a booking — arrange the journey yourselves.
appts.followUpTasks: Things to do next (optional, one per line)
appts.followUpTasksHint: Each line becomes a task in the circle, for example “Book blood test”.
appts.summaryCaveat: As reported by a family member or caregiver — not an official medical record.

tasks.title: Task
tasks.titleHint: For example “Buy BP medicine” or “Pay electricity bill”.

visits.selfReported: Check-in and check-out times are what the visitor reports. CareNest can't confirm someone was physically there.
visits.observations: How was {name}? What did you do?
visits.unresolvedIssues: Anything unresolved that someone needs to deal with? (optional)
visits.detailsHidden: Notes are only visible to people {name} shares health information with.

updates.title: Updates
updates.intro: Short notes for everyone in the circle: how {name} is, what happened, what others should know.
updates.body: What would you like to share?
updates.corrected: A later update corrects this one.
updates.healthNote: Health and mood notes are only shown to people {name} shares health information with.

timeline.title: Care timeline
timeline.intro: Everything recorded for {name}, newest first. Each entry shows who recorded it.

emergency.title: Emergency
emergency.callHint: Local emergency number. Calling is always the fastest way to get emergency help.
emergency.notService: CareNest is not an emergency service. It alerts your family and caregivers; it does not contact the police, ambulance or fire service.
emergency.confirmBody: Everyone set up to respond will get an urgent alert. If you are in danger, call {number} first.
emergency.shareLocation: Share my location with my family for this alert only
emergency.locationFailed: Your location couldn't be shared, but the alert will still be sent.
emergency.practiceConfirm: Send a clearly labelled PRACTICE alert to the first people on the list? It won't escalate.
emergency.activeTitle: A request for help is in progress
emergency.infoIntro: Everyone in the circle can see this card, including emergency contacts. Add only what a responder needs.
emergency.field_advanceDirectiveNote: Advance care wishes (where documents are kept)
emergency.field_homeAccessNote: Getting into the home (keys, gate code)
emergency.contactsIntro: People are alerted tier by tier: tier 1 first, then tier 2 after {minutes} minutes without a response, and so on, then everyone.
emergency.phoneOnly: Phone only — no automatic alert (CareNest has no SMS yet)
emergency.contactMember: Link to a circle member (they then get alerts)
emergency.noContacts: No emergency contacts yet. Without tiers, everyone in the circle is alerted at once.
emergency.locationLink: Open shared location on a map
emergency.noResponse: Nobody has responded yet ({minutes} min). Call {number} if this is an emergency, and phone the contacts below.
emergency.nextStep: Next group will be alerted at {when} if nobody responds.
emergency.falseAlarmConfirm: Cancel this request? Everyone alerted will be told it was a false alarm.
emergency.noDeliveries: Nobody in CareNest has been alerted.
emergency.noEmailProvider: This server can't send email yet, so alerts only reach people who open CareNest. Phone people directly.
emergency.phoneThese: Phone these people yourself (they don't get CareNest alerts)
emergency.liveNote: This page refreshes itself every 15 seconds while the request is open.

simple.medsNone: No medicines to take right now.
simple.refused: I don't want to take it
simple.savedTaken: Thank you. Saved as taken at {time}.
simple.savedOther: Thank you. Your family can see this.
simple.apptNoDriver: Nobody has said yet who will take you.
simple.nothingComing: Nothing planned for today or tomorrow.
simple.noContacts: Ask your family to add their phone numbers.
simple.sentOk: Thank you. Your family will see your message.
simple.sentUnwell: Your family has been told. If it is serious, call {number}.

data.title: Your data
data.intro: Download a copy of everything CareNest holds about you, or delete your account.
data.downloadHint: A file (JSON) with your account, circles, signed-in devices and what you wrote. It never includes your password.
data.deleteIntro: This signs you out everywhere and removes your account, memberships and notifications. Care notes and medicine records you wrote stay in the care history so the family keeps a complete record, but your name is removed from them. This cannot be undone.
data.deleteLastManager: If you are the only person who can manage a care circle, make someone else an admin (or archive the circle) first.
data.circleExportHint: A complete copy of this circle's records (medicines, doses, appointments, tasks, visits, updates, emergency details and the activity log). Downloading is recorded in the activity log.

today.title: Today for {name}
today.notAVerdict: This shows what people have recorded in CareNest. It can't tell you how {name} is. If you're worried, call them.
today.attentionNone: Nothing in CareNest needs attention right now.
today.attnHelp: Help was requested at {time}. Open it now.
today.apptsNone: No appointments in the next 7 days.
today.tasksUnassigned: Waiting for someone to take them: {count}

push.title: Alerts on this device
push.intro: Get CareNest alerts as notifications on this phone or computer, even when CareNest is closed. Turn this on on each device you use.
push.turnOn: Turn on alerts on this device
push.turnOff: Turn off alerts on this device
push.on: Alerts are on for this device.
push.testSent: Test alert sent. It should appear within a few seconds.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for CareNest in this browser's settings. Allow them there, then try again.
push.unsupported: This browser can't show CareNest alerts.
push.subscribeFailed: This browser couldn't turn on alerts. Private or incognito windows can't receive them: open CareNest in a normal window and try again.
push.iosHint: On an iPhone or iPad, first add CareNest to your Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen), open it from there, then turn alerts on.
push.notConfigured: Phone alerts aren't set up on this CareNest server yet.
push.quietNote: Quiet hours apply to phone alerts too, except urgent ones such as a request for help. Everyday news isn't sent to your phone; it comes in the evening summary.

calendar.name: CareNest – {circle}
calendar.title: Add to your calendar
calendar.intro: See {name}'s appointments and visits, and your own tasks, in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook. The link is private to you: anyone who has it can see these events, so don't share it.
calendar.privacy: Calendars get only titles, times, places and who is driving: never reasons for a visit, questions for the doctor or health notes.
calendar.linkReady: Your calendar link. For your safety it is shown only now, so copy it or open it in your calendar app:
calendar.howTo: Google Calendar: Other calendars → + → From URL, and paste the link. iPhone: Settings → Calendar → Accounts → Add Account → Other → Add Subscribed Calendar. Outlook: Add calendar → Subscribe from web.
calendar.active: You have a calendar link, made on {date}.
calendar.lastFetched: Your calendar app last updated it: {date}
calendar.neverFetched: No calendar app has used it yet.
calendar.reset: Make a new link (the old one stops working)
calendar.turnOffConfirm: Your calendar app will stop showing these events. Continue?
